assessment.why: The bottle Elon says he placed on the shelf is the cyanide-containing historical original, and he handled the donor glass. That is a defensible circumstantial accusation, although innocent mistaken identity and earlier miniature dosing by another remain credible.

plausibility_notes: Contaminated miniature plausibly transferred poison to an apparently empty glass before punch; trace residue need not register in photographs.
Exterior plaster/fibers establish innocent handling readily; neither demonstrates inside-glass dosing.
Fragment in folded favor paper is strong only if its particular owner or placement can be reconstructed.
